lines: Mind the smithing table. What do you need?
Step clear of the smithing table. What do you need?
Mind the hot metal. I'm listening.
There you are. Need something fixed?
Morning. Give me a moment to set this down.
Good to see you. Nothing broken, I hope.
If you need me, speak up over the hammering.
You caught me between repairs. What is it?
Hello. Set anything sharp on the bench first.
I have a moment. What can I do for you?
Come in. Just watch where you put your hands.
Need a tool, a repair, or a bit of advice?
Hello. I can listen while this iron cools.
You look like you came with a job for me.
Give me a second to clamp this. There. What is it?
Welcome. If it rattles, leave it on the bench.
I was about to take a break anyway. Go on.
Tell me how it broke before you show me the damage.
Careful by the vise. Now, how can I help?
You have my attention. Make good use of it.
